title: Compare a report with current code
summary: Reruns a saved or pasted report and shows before / delta / after
intro: Read this when a DocInsight report, a tester sheet or a chart may have gone stale: compare reruns its COMMAND against the current index and diffs the normalised text, a forms CSV by row, or a chart by nodes and edges.

help: drag-lint compare            --in <U.pas> --line <L> [--update-doc]            the remarks block at the caret (S1)
drag-lint compare            --show <report|csv|bundle> [--json] [--output <f.html>] [--open]   any report as the HTML page
Reruns the old report's COMMAND in-process (no PowerShell) and diffs the normalised
text: exit 0 same, 1 differences, 2 usage/setup, 3 stale index. Diff ignores step numbers,
:line anchors, the header date/engine, BUNDLE/INDEX/AS OF/REGENERATE lines and wrapping.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Reports > Compare a Saved Report or Chart with Current Code...
steps: drag-lint > Reports > Compare a Saved Report or Chart with Current Code...
Yes picks a saved report .txt, forms .csv or chart .dot; No picks a chart bundle folder
Read before / delta / after in drag-lint-compare.txt (an empty delta means the report is still true)

questions.ask: Is the report under the caret still true?
Compare a saved report with today's answer
